title: Native-image source audit
intro: A01 teaches source-preserving image measurements with honest pixel/metadata limitations. Browser checks use synthetic numbers, and the local A01 CLI handles genuine TIFF/OME-TIFF.

scientific_context.caution: These checks do not certify original acquisition or physical calibration.

chapter_method: Predict → Run → Investigate → Apply → independent Prove → delayed review. Complete original TIFF verification in local Python.

goals.title: Select channel and Z by named axes
goals.why: A wrong axis silently changes which biological plane is measured.
explain: Explicitly index named channel and Z axes, never guess from dimension positions.
Return a real 2-D YX plane; do not silently collapse ambiguous dimensions.

worked_example.code:
import numpy as np
x=np.arange(2*3*4*5).reshape(2,3,4,5)
print('ZCYX',x.shape,'one YX plane',x[1,2].shape)
